documents.title: CET1 down to 20.17% at June 2026
documents.excerpt: CET1 capital of €346.8M on €1,719M of risk-weighted assets gives 20.17%, down from 20.52% fully loaded at December 2025. Headroom over the 14.28% overall capital requirement is 5.9 points.

documents.title: Net fees now exceed net interest income
documents.excerpt: Net fee income reached €91.6M against net interest income of €80.8M. Gross fees rose 33% to €132.9M as Tressis and the Spanish bank joined the group; fees are 46% of net operating income.

documents.title: Net interest income down 6.6% as rates fall
documents.excerpt: Interest income fell from €102.3M to €95.9M as ECB cuts repriced the treasury portfolio. Net interest income dropped from €86.5M to €80.8M while the loan book grew 13.5% to €1.72Bn.

documents.title: International subsidiaries profit up 60%
documents.excerpt: Switzerland, the United States and Spain (Tressis, Banco Europeo de Finanzas, Casa Vicens) earned €8.1M, up 60%. More than half of the €20.1Bn of AUM is now held outside Andorra.

documents.title: Efficiency ratio 60.1% vs EU average 55.0%
documents.excerpt: Staff costs rose 26% to €60.4M with 584 people, 30% more than three years ago. The efficiency ratio of 60.06% compares with an EU significant-institution average of 54.95%.
